title: event-discount-codes.html
content: {{variable.Object_Code_plural}} can be used for specific {{variable.Object_Event}} s, or {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s. Three types of Codes can be added to Events and Event Items: Discount: decreases the dollar amount an individual will pay Access-Promo: access to proceed or purchase an item or a promotional code for an item benefit Source: While the “Source” option can track a code to follow a user through a flow, like an embedded URL, we recommend using a UTM parameter for tracking instead. Prerequisites Licenses Codes are a part of the Blackthorn Payments package. The user configuring discount Codes will need a license for the Payments app. Page Layout Updates Code Eligibility Object If you do not see the {{variable.Field_CodeEligi_Event}} or {{variable.Field_CodeEligi_EventItem}} fields on the Code Eligibility record, update the page layout to include them. Event Item Object Add the Code Eligibility’s Related List to the Event Item object. Important Functionality Discount Codes are only supported for the Full-Width, Tabbed, and Dynamic UI experiences. Using a discount Code with the Simple UI will cause the checkout process to fail. Discount Codes are not supported for Sessions. Create a Discount Code Click on the App Launcher. Enter and select “ {{variable.Object_Code_plural}} .” Click {{variable.button_new}} . Define the following fields: Enter the {{variable.Field_Code_CodeName}} . (required) Choose a {{variable.Field_Code_ValidFrom}} date. Choose the {{variable.Field_Code_ValidThrough}} date. NOTE: {{variable.Field_Code_ValidFrom}} and {{variable.Field_Code_ValidThrough}} dates are enforced depending on which field is set. {{variable.Field_Code_RestrictToAccount}} (If set, only {{variable.Object_Contact}} associated to the {{variable.Object_Account}} can use the {{variable.Object_Code}} .) Enter the {{variable.Field_Code_QuantityMadeAvailab}} . NOTE: {{variable.Field_Code_QuantityMadeAvailab}} is enforced only when populated (leave blank for unlimited uses). The related {{variable.Field_Code_QuantityClaimed}} field is updated every time a {{variable.Object_Code}} is used on an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} for an {{variable.Object_Event}} or {{variable.Object_EventItem}} . If an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_Status}} = "Void", the {{variable.Object_Code}} is released, and the {{variable.Field_Code_QuantityClaimed}} is updated. Select “Discount” in the {{variable.Field_Code_Type}} field. Enter the {{variable.Field_Code_DiscountAmount}} or the {{variable.Field_Code_DiscountPercentage}} . Enter a {{variable.Field_Code_Description}} . Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Create a Code Eligibility Record to Relate an Event or Event Item Select a {{variable.Field_CodeEligi_Code}} . Choose either an {{variable.Field_CodeEligi_Event}} or an {{variable.Field_CodeEligi_EventItem}} . NOTE: {{variable.Object_CodeEligibility}} can only be added to one of them. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Enable the Discount Code on your Event Page Go to the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Set the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CodeSettings}} field to “Optional,” “Hide,” or “Required.” If {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CodeSettings}} = “Required” on the {{variable.Object_Event}} , all {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s must have an associated {{variable.Object_Code}} . Registrants won't be able to proceed with checkout unless they have the valid {{variable.Object_Code}} . If {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CodeSettings}} = “Optional,” then a registrant isn’t required to enter a {{variable.Object_Code}} even if the {{variable.Object_Code}} was set on the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} level. If {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CodeSettings}} = “Hide,” the {{variable.Object_Code}} will be hidden throughout the checkout process. Code Discount Amount Field The amount an {{variable.Object_EventItem}} 's {{variable.Object_LineItem}} was discounted by using a {{variable.Object_Code}} is calculated and stored in the {{variable.Field_LineItem_CodeDiscountAmt}} field on the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} 's {{variable.Object_LineItem}} on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} . Multiple Registrants and a Discount Code When a group of {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s registers for an {{variable.Object_Event}} as a group and uses a discount {{variable.Object_Code}} during checkout, the discount {{variable.Object_Code}} will be applied to the group’s total cost and found on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} record. The discount {{variable.Object_Code}} will not be applied to each {{variable.Object_Attendee}} individually during the checkout process. Create an Access-Promo Code If no discount is offered, {{variable.Object_Code}} s can also give users special permission to purchase an {{variable.Object_EventItem}} (i.e., Ticket or Product) or to access an {{variable.Object_EventItem}} benefit. Enter the {{variable.Field_Code_CodeName}} . (required) Choose a {{variable.Field_Code_ValidFrom}} date. Choose the {{variable.Field_Code_ValidThrough}} date. NOTE: {{variable.Field_Code_ValidFrom}} and {{variable.Field_Code_ValidThrough}} dates are enforced depending on which field is set. {{variable.Field_Code_RestrictToAccount}} (If set, only {{variable.Object_Contact}} associated to the {{variable.Object_Account}} can use the {{variable.Object_Code}} .) Enter the {{variable.Field_Code_QuantityMadeAvailab}} . NOTE: {{variable.Field_Code_QuantityMadeAvailab}} is enforced only when populated (leave blank for unlimited uses). The related {{variable.Field_Code_QuantityClaimed}} field is updated every time a {{variable.Object_Code}} is used on an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} for an {{variable.Object_Event}} or {{variable.Object_EventItem}} . If an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_Status}} = "Void", the {{variable.Object_Code}} is released, and the {{variable.Field_Code_QuantityClaimed}} is updated. Select “Access-Promo” in the {{variable.Field_Code_Type}} field. Enter the {{variable.Field_Code_DiscountAmount}} or the {{variable.Field_Code_DiscountPercentage}} . Enter a {{variable.Field_Code_Description}} . Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Create a Code Eligibility Record to Relate an Event or Event Item Select a {{variable.Field_CodeEligi_Code}} . Choose either an {{variable.Field_CodeEligi_Event}} or an {{variable.Field_CodeEligi_EventItem}} . NOTE: {{variable.Object_CodeEligibility}} can only be added to one of them. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Enable Discount Codes on your Event Record Go to the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Set the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CodeSettings}} = “Required.” NOTE: This will make the Access-Promo Code required at the Event level. Code Discount Amount The amount an {{variable.Object_EventItem}} 's {{variable.Object_LineItem}} was discounted by using a {{variable.Object_Code}} is calculated and stored in the {{variable.Field_LineItem_CodeDiscountAmt}} field on the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} 's {{variable.Object_LineItem}} on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} . Reserve Seats for Attendees You can also use an access-promo Code to reserve seats for Attendees by updating the following. Code Eligibility Record On the Code Eligibility record, select an Event in the {{variable.Field_CodeEligi_Event}} field. Do not use the {{variable.Field_CodeEligi_EventItem}} field. Event Record On the Event record, set the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CodeSettings}} field to “Required.” This will prevent Attendees from registering for the Event without using the access-promo Code. FAQ Q: How many Code Eligibility records can be enabled on an Event or an Event Item? A: There is no known limit for the number of related {{variable.Object_CodeEligibility}} records that can be enabled on an {{variable.Object_Event}} or an {{variable.Object_EventItem}} . Q: Can only one promo Code be used at a time? Or can users stack promo Codes? A: Only ONE promo {{variable.Object_Code}} can be used during checkout. If an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} has a few codes available for a given {{variable.Object_Event}} they can be swapped but not stacked. Q: Can I use a discount Code in the Experience Cloud? A: Yes, you can use discount {{variable.Object_Code}} s in the {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} if the following criteria are met. A user logged into an {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} site as a {{variable.Object_Contact}} related to an {{variable.Object_Account}} can apply a discount {{variable.Object_Code}} if... The {{variable.Object_Account}} is related to a discount {{variable.Object_Code}} . The {{variable.Object_Code}} ’s {{variable.Field_Code_RestrictToAccount}} field is set to “True.” A user logged into an {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} site as a {{variable.Object_Contact}} related to an {{variable.Object_Account}} cannot apply the discount {{variable.Object_Code}} if... The {{variable.Object_Account}} is NOT connected to a discount {{variable.Object_Code}} . The {{variable.Object_Code}} ’s {{variable.Field_Code_RestrictToAccount}} field is set to “True.”
